title: Synthetic scanned-article OCR post-process demo
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC example. The input text was written by hand and seeded with artificial OCR errors for demonstration; it does not come from a real scanned document.

output_contract.corrected_text: UTF-8 corrected OCR text, same pagination (form feeds preserved)
output_contract.change_log: JSONL; every applied edit with page, line, col, before, after, rule, confidence
output_contract.qc_metrics: before/after suspicious-token rates, counts by rule, remaining candidates, per-line heat
output_contract.uncertainty: deferred or rejected candidates with reasons (review list)
